target.title: Plan grouped Claw agent updates
target.body:
## Summary

- add `openclaw.clawUpdatePlan.v1` for read-only, agent-centric reconciliation of a grouped Claw manifest
- add `openclaw claws update <claw-or-agent> [--from <source>] --dry-run [--json]` behind `OPENCLAW_EXPERIMENTAL_CLAWS=1`
- resolve the normal target from persisted add provenance; keep `--from` as an explicit override and recovery path
- compare effective agent capabilities, workspace files, exact package refs, MCP declarations, and agent-pinned cron declarations
- bind the complete preview to `planIntegrity` for the consented apply slice
- perform no mutation: planning opens existing state read-only, does not create or migrate databases, and closes every owned handle

## Planning contract

- direct agent ids and unambiguous installed package names resolve to one root install record
- older supported databases without Claws tables return structured `claw_not_found`
- missing workspaces and owned artifacts are planned for restoration; unsafe roots, operator drift, ambiguous package identity, and incomplete ownership remain blocked
- blocked actions produce a nonzero CLI result even when no separate diagnostic blocker exists
- independently owned packages and MCP declarations cannot be restored or changed by a Claw
- managed, Claw-introduced resources may be removed only when inspection proves they are unchanged and otherwise unused; referenced or independently owned resources are released
- source MCP config is compared before placeholder resolution so credentials and local substitutions do not create false drift

## Capability and consent contract

- capability changes use secret-safe summaries plus SHA-256 digests; raw MCP configuration and cron payloads never enter the plan model
- effective sandbox values come from OpenClaw's production resolver, including inherited defaults
- widening workspace access, sandbox sharing, tool access, plugin code, MCP surfaces, or scheduled automation requires distinct escalation consent
- reductions and blocked removals do not request escalation consent

## Real behavior proof

Current head: `0eef342ada1275d02142d4702803c09957a9c664`.

An isolated v1 Claw was added with integrity-bound consent, then v2 introduced a remote OAuth MCP URL containing `URL_SECRET_123`, a secret-like tool filter, and cron message `CRON_SECRET_ABC`.

Human preview:

```text
Claw update plan: @proof/safe-preview 1.0.0 -> 2.0.0
Agent: safe-preview
Update actions: 4
Capability changes: 5; escalations requiring distinct consent: 3
  - agent.sandbox.mode: off -> all (change)
  - agent.sandbox.scope: agent -> session (change)
  ! agent.sandbox.workspaceAccess: none -> ro (change)
  ! cronJobs.private-report: unset -> schedule cron; session isolated; payload withheld (add)
  ! mcpServers.private-search: unset -> remote server; auth configured; tool filter configured (add)
```

JSON emitted only paths, classifications, summaries, and digests. It contained none of `secret.example.test`, `URL_SECRET_123`, `PRIVATE_TOOL_SECRET_456`, or `CRON_SECRET_ABC`.

## Verification

- focused update planner and CLI: 46 tests passed
- real Claw lifecycle E2E: 8 tests passed
- broader Claw unit coverage: 95 tests passed during the restack
- Oxfmt, focused Oxlint, repository guardrails, import-cycle checks, and `git diff --check` passed
- direct core tsgo reached only the existing shared `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` dependency errors; changed files reported no type errors
- `codex review --base ec41651ee29aa40573420ef00b038c56d155a797`: accepted findings fixed; one source-migration suggestion rejected because valid Claw packages constrain `source` to the literal `"clawhub"`

## Stack

- RFC: https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/27
- Depends on: #102427 read-only diagnostics
- This PR: authoritative read-only update planning and consent boundary
- Next: #102982 executes only a freshly rebuilt, unblocked, consent-matched plan
